title: PATCH /api/notifications/:nid/read — mark notification as read
description: Mark a single notification as read. Also support PATCH /api/notifications/read-all to mark all as read.
acceptanceCriteria: Returns 404 if notification doesn't belong to user
POST /api/notifications/read-all marks all user notifications as read

steps.details: PATCH /:nid/read: Find notification WHERE id = nid AND user_id = userId. Set is_read = true. Return 200. POST /read-all: UPDATE notifications SET is_read = true WHERE user_id = userId AND is_read = false. Return 200 { updated: rowCount }.
Mark one notification read — verify is_read = true. Call read-all — verify all are read.
